title: BRICS Sports Ministers Adopt Joint Declaration in Visakhapatnam
detail: India hosted the BRICS Sports Ministers' Meeting in Visakhapatnam on August 23, 2026, the second day of the Youth and Sports ministerial track under its 2026 BRICS Chairship. Heads of delegation from Brazil, China, Egypt, Ethiopia, India, Indonesia, Iran, Russia, Saudi Arabia, South Africa and the UAE adopted the BRICS Sports Joint Declaration by consensus. Union Minister Dr Mansukh Mandaviya called for a 'BRICS Sporting Partnership' moving beyond declarations into tangible collaboration, and ministers backed two new initiatives: a BRICS Sports Manufacturing Conclave, with Udaipur volunteering to host its inaugural edition in November 2026, and a non-competitive BRICS Games showcasing traditional and indigenous sporting heritage, proposed for Ahmedabad on October 12-13, 2026. Ministers from India, UAE, Indonesia, Egypt, Iran, Ethiopia and South Africa also joined a BRICS Friendship Cycling ride as part of the 87th 'Fit India Sundays' edition.

title: 18th BRICS Academic Forum Convenes in Lucknow
detail: The 18th BRICS Academic Forum convened in Lucknow from August 23-25, 2026, organized by the Observer Research Foundation (ORF) in partnership with the Research and Information System for Developing Countries (RIS) and the University of Lucknow, under India's 2026 BRICS Chairship. Academics, researchers, experts and policymakers from BRICS member states gathered under the Chairship theme 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability' to discuss AI, quantum technology, digital infrastructure and global governance, marking 20 years since the BRIC(S) acronym was coined and offering a forum to reflect on the bloc's evolution ahead of the September 12-13 New Delhi Leaders' Summit.
